subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: After compaction and oversized-result recovery are exhausted, should a replay-safe context overflow enter the configured model fallback chain when a candidate has a larger verified context window?
rationale: The choice changes core fallback semantics and must define replay safety, canonical model-window trust, required headroom, and terminal behavior when no eligible fallback exists.

options.title: Guarded larger-model fallback
options.body: Allow fallback only for replay-safe exhausted overflow results and only to candidates with sufficient context headroom resolved through the canonical runtime metadata path.

options.title: Keep compaction-only policy
options.body: Continue returning the blocked recovery result and document manual model or session recovery as the supported policy.

recommendation.title: Guarded larger-model fallback
recommendation.body: Allow fallback only for replay-safe exhausted overflow results and only to candidates with sufficient context headroom resolved through the canonical runtime metadata path.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and recent central-path maintenance signals make this the strongest available owner for the product choice.
